statement: Components/subdocuments can be modeled when structure matters without forcing every document into maximal decomposition.
Stable identity of a document part can differ from its current display number/name across versions.
actakit_implication: Never use article number, filename or title as the stable primary identity of a mutable civic/document part.

statement: Akoma Ntoso explicitly applies proportionality of impact: rare cases should not complicate frequent cases.
actakit_implication: Keep DocumentPart/Collection/profile machinery optional and pay complexity only when a fixture requires it.

statement: A mature legal-document vocabulary continued evolving after adoption in response to implementation and interoperability needs.
actakit_implication: Version document profiles/locators so ActaKit can evolve without treating the first profile set as final ontology.
